title: Bitcoin Price Hovers Near $80,000 as Traders Await Fed Decision
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Hovers Near $80,000 as Traders Await Fed Decision Bitcoin price hovers near $80,000 as traders wait on this week’s Fed decision, with geopolitical tensions and Anthropic’s possible IPO adding to the uncertainty. This post Bitcoin Price Hovers Near $80,000 as Traders Await Fed Decision first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
